name: update_stop
description: Edit a stop's name, pinnedTime, pinnedEndTime, legMode or notes. Only the parameters you pass are changed. Send null for pinnedTime, pinnedEndTime or notes to clear them. Returns the full updated trip.

stopId.description: Id of the stop to edit, from get_trip.

pinnedTime.description: Fixed start time, HH:mm local to the place. May run past midnight, up to 47:59. Send null to clear it and let the app schedule the stop.

pinnedEndTime.description: Fixed end time, HH:mm local to the place. May run past midnight, up to 47:59. Send null to clear it and let the app schedule the stop.

legMode.description: How you travel to this stop: auto, walk, drive, cycle or other.

notes.description: Free text for this stop, at most 2000 characters. Send null or an empty string to clear it.
